notes.title: Big Update!
notes.content:
Hi guys. 
We have good news, we have already updated build of our game and

Added option to change controls
Added dash indicator
Added weapon indicator
Minor changes at player physics
Minor bug fixes


Thanks for the attention
Have a good day
